                              Director, Office of Technical Certification and Research

     Issuance Date:           December 22, 2015

     Effective Date:          March 22, 2016

            Purpose:          This document establishes qualification criteria and submittal requirements for approved pipe
                              welder qualification agencies and the welder’s employer.

           Related             MC     1210.2.2      1 RCNY     101-07
       Code/Zoning            FGC     406.1.1.1
        Section(s):

          Subject(s):         Gas piping systems, welder; High pressure steam piping systems, welder; Pipe welder,
                              approved pipe welder qualifying agency; Pipe welder, qualification criteria


Welding of gas or high pressure steam piping systems must be performed by welders qualified for all ranges and
welding variables in accordance with the NYC Construction Codes Sections MC 1210.2.2 or FGC 406.1.1.1, and
Section IX of ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code.

A. Submittal Requirements for Approved Pipe Welder Qualifying Agencies
Approved pipe welder qualifying agencies shall be approved in accordance with 1 RCNY 101-07 Section (C)(8) and
shall comply with the following:
    1. Required documents.
            a. Initial approval. Approved pipe welder qualifying agencies must submit all welder qualification
                reports (WQR’s), and continuity records as required in accordance with Section (B)(1) of this
                bulletin.
            b. Requalification. Approved pipe welder qualifying agencies must submit all requalification
                documents as required in accordance with Section (B)(3) of this bulletin.
    2. Submittal Address. Forward all submittal requirements to OTCR@buildings.nyc.gov.
    3. Frequency. Approved pipe welder qualifying agencies must submit the above referenced required
        documents twice monthly: on the 1st and 15th of each month.
    4. Approval. The Department will review all qualification reports submitted as required above. Approved
        agencies will be notified if a qualification report is not accepted. A list of approved welders will be
        published on the Department’s website.

B. Welder Qualification Criteria
Qualified pipe welders must comply with the following:
   1. Proof of Qualification. The following items are required to demonstrate proof of pipe welder
        qualifications:

               a. Welders Qualification Report (WQR) –Include all information indicated on the QW-484, along
                  with:
                            Approved Agency information:         Contractor/Employer information:
                            Agency Name                          Company Name
                            Name of CWI who witnessed            Contractor representative
                            weld test                            witnessing weld test
                            CWI Certification Number             Representative signature
                            CWI Signature                        Date of welder qualification
                            CWI Stamp
                            Date of welder qualification

              b. Continuity Record. Continuity records must be maintained by the welder’s employer and shall
                   demonstrate that the pipe welder has performed welding work within the last 6 months, as required.
     2.   Date of Qualification. The date of qualification, as indicated on the WQR, must pre-date any pipe welding
          activity performed on the project. If a production weld is used for qualification as per ASME Section IX,
          QW-304.1, then the qualification date may coincide with the welding activity.
     3.   Requalification.
              a. Gas Pipe Welders – must obtain requalification from an Approved Agency every year in
                   accordance with Section FGC 406.1.1.1.
              b. High Pressure Steam Welders – must obtain requalification from an Approved Agency every 5
                   years in accordance with Section MC 1210.2.2.
     4.   Unacceptable Qualifications. The following are not acceptable forms of proof for demonstrating pipe
          welder qualification:
              a. A Department of Buildings Structural Welder License
              b. Welder certification from a utility
              c. A WQR from an agency not approved by the Department of Buildings
     5.   Transfer of Welder Qualifications. Qualified welders do not need to obtain requalification when changing
          employers if:
                           a. all employers belong to participating organizations, and
                           b. the employing organization verifies welders continuity by previous employer since
                                qualification date.
     6.   Verification of Welder Qualifications. It is the responsibility of the permit holder to verify the qualifications
          of pipe welders prior to any welding. A list of approved welders will be published on the Department’s
          website.
